types.name: AccountHealth
types.description: Account Health metric group. A null value for a given metric means that this metric is not yet available.

fields.name: accountHealthAtozClaimOrderCount
fields.description: Total number of orders with an A-to-z Guarantee claim that was not denied, applies to seller-fulfilled orders only.

fields.name: accountHealthAtozGuaranteeClaimRate
fields.description: Ratio of orders with A-to-z Guarantee claims to total orders.

fields.name: accountHealthChargebackClaimOrderCount
fields.description:
Total number of orders that resulted in a credit card chargeback, applies to
both seller-fulfilled and amazon-fulfilled orders.

fields.name: accountHealthChargebackClaimRate
fields.description: Ratio of orders with chargeback claims to total orders.

fields.name: accountHealthLateShipmentOrderCount
fields.description: Number of seller-fulfilled orders where shipping confirmation was completed after the expected ship date.

fields.name: accountHealthLateShipmentRate
fields.description: Percentage of total orders with late ship confirmation.

fields.name: accountHealthNegativeFeedbackOrderCount
fields.description:
Total number of orders that received negative feedback within a specific time
period, applies to both seller-fulfilled and amazon-fulfilled orders.

fields.name: accountHealthNegativeFeedbackRate
fields.description: Ratio of orders receiving negative feedback to total orders.

fields.name: accountHealthOnTimeDeliveryDefectPackageCount
fields.description: Number of seller-fulfilled packages that were not delivered on time.

fields.name: accountHealthOnTimeDeliveryDefectPackageUnits
fields.description: Number of units in seller-fulfilled packages that were not delivered on time.

fields.name: accountHealthOnTimeDeliveryRate
fields.description: Percentage of seller-fulfilled items delivered by the 'Deliver by' date.

fields.name: accountHealthOrderCount
fields.description:
Total number of orders placed by customers within a specified time frame,
applies to both seller-fulfilled and amazon-fulfilled orders.

fields.name: accountHealthOrderDefectRate
fields.description: Percentage of orders with defects (negative feedback, A-to-z claims not denied, or chargebacks).

fields.name: accountHealthPackageCount
fields.description: Number of seller-fulfilled shipments within a specific time period.

fields.name: accountHealthPackageUnits
fields.description: Number of units in seller-fulfilled shipments within a specific time period.

fields.name: accountHealthPreFulfillmentCancelOrderCount
fields.description: Number of seller-fulfilled orders cancelled by sellers.

fields.name: accountHealthPreFulfillmentCancelRate
fields.description: Percentage of seller-cancelled orders during a given period.

fields.name: accountHealthRatingScore
fields.description: 0-1,000 point scale indicating account suspension risk based on compliance with Amazon's selling policies.

fields.name: accountHealthTotalOrderDefects
fields.description:
Total number of order defects identified by Account Health Dashboard (a tool in Seller Central
that tracks a seller's compliance with Amazon's selling policies and performance metrics) within a specified time period.

fields.name: accountHealthValidTrackingDefectPackageCount
fields.description: Number of defective shipments due to missing valid tracking information, applies to seller-fulfilled orders only.

fields.name: accountHealthValidTrackingRate
fields.description: Percentage of packages with valid tracking over total packages shipped.

fields.name: regionDistinctCountDefectTypeT120Days
fields.description:
Count of distinct defect types identified in the region over the past 120 days
(snapshot data, always returns latest value).

fields.name: regionInaccurateProductDefectRateT120Days
fields.description:
Regional defect rate for products with inaccurate product information over the
past 120 days (snapshot data, always returns latest value).

fields.name: regionIncorrectLabelDefectRateT120Days
fields.description:
Regional defect rate for products with incorrect labeling over the past 120
days (snapshot data, always returns latest value).

fields.name: regionLabelMissingDefectRateT120Days
fields.description: Regional defect rate for products with missing labels over the past 120 days (snapshot data, always returns latest value).

fields.name: regionOtherDefectsProductRelatedDefectRateT120Days
fields.description:
Regional defect rate for other product-related defects not covered by specific
categories over the past 120 days (snapshot data, always returns latest value).

fields.name: regionResolvedDefectsUnitT120Days
fields.description:
Number of regional product defect units that were resolved over the past 120 days.
This is snapshot data that reflects the current state at query time.
When querying with daily or weekly granularity, the same latest value is returned for each time period.

fields.name: regionUnexpectedProductDefectRateT120Days
fields.description: Regional defect rate for unexpected product issues over the past 120 days (snapshot data, always returns latest value).

fields.name: sellerAnalyticsView
fields.description:
A query to retrieve cross-domain seller analytics data for the seller's account,
aggregated by provided GroupByAttributes.

args.name: startDate
args.description: The start date of the seller analytics data to retrieve. The start date must be no more than two years ago.

args.name: endDate
args.description: The end date of the seller analytics data to retrieve.

args.name: aggregateBy
args.description: Determines how the data is aggregated. For example: daily, weekly, or monthly.

args.name: currencyCode
args.description: Currency code for all monetary amounts in ISO 4217 format. If not provided, amounts are returned in USD.

args.name: marketplaceId
args.description: The marketplace identifiers to retrieve cross-domain seller analytics.

types.name: Boolean
types.description: Represents `true` or `false` values.

types.name: CountMetrics
types.description:
Delivery speed-related count metrics for search performance.
Captures customer interactions (impressions, clicks, cart adds, purchases) filtered by shipping speed availability.

fields.name: shippingCartAdd
fields.description: Number of cart additions where the specified delivery speed option was available.

fields.name: shippingClick
fields.description: Number of clicks where the specified delivery speed option was available.

fields.name: shippingImpression
fields.description: Number of impressions where the specified delivery speed option was available.

fields.name: shippingPurchase
fields.description: Number of purchases where the specified delivery speed option was available.

types.name: DateGranularity

enumValues.description: Metrics are aggregated by day.

enumValues.name: WEEK
enumValues.description: Metrics are aggregated by week.

enumValues.name: MONTH
enumValues.description: Metrics are aggregated by month.

Defects metric group for return-defect analytics. A null value for a given
metric means that this metric is not yet available.

fields.name: topics
fields.description:
Return-defect metrics grouped by defect topic.
Returns an array of metrics per unique return-defect topic within the current grouping context.

fields.name: totalDefectFrequency
fields.description: Total frequency of return defects across all topics for the product (trailing six months). Not supported under totals.

types.name: Float

types.name: FloatWithBenchmarking

fields.name: brand

fields.name: brandCode

fields.name: encryptedMerchantCustomerId
fields.description: Masked version of internal merchant identifier using encryption algorithm.

fields.name: fulfilmentChannel
fields.description: The fulfillment channel for the product, indicating whether it is fulfilled by Amazon (FBA) or by the seller (FBM).

fields.name: marketplaceId
fields.description: The marketplace identifier for the associated metrics.

fields.name: msku
fields.description: Merchant Level Stock Keeping Unit.

fields.name: parentAsin
fields.description:
Products with variations (size, color, etc.) have a Parent ASIN and Child
ASINs. The Parent ASIN represents the generic overall product
(non-purchasable).

fields.name: productGroup
fields.description:
The product group which describes the business group, as defined by the Amazon
catalog, for example, PC, Wireless, Major Appliances.

fields.name: productTitle
fields.description: Product name.

types.name: Int
types.description: Represents non-fractional signed whole numeric values. Int can represent values between -(2^31) and 2^31 - 1.

types.name: IntWithBenchmarking

types.name: Lending
types.description: Lending metric group. A null value for a given metric means that this metric is not yet available.

fields.name: disbursements
fields.description: Total monetary amount disbursed to the seller from Amazon for sales and other transactions.

fields.name: feedbackOrderCount
fields.description: Total number of orders that received customer feedback within a specified time period.

fields.name: primaryProductCategory
fields.description: Product category where seller achieved highest percentage of sales over past 12 months.

fields.name: primaryProductCategoryNetGMS
fields.description: Total Gross Merchandise Sales generated in seller's main product category as of current day.

fields.name: refundsOrderCount
fields.description: Total number of orders that resulted in refunds within a specified time period.

fields.name: totalBalanceByStandardOrders
fields.description: Total balance amount generated from standard order transactions.

fields.name: totalFbaInventoryValue
fields.description: Total worth of seller's inventory stored in FBA warehouses based on 15-day average selling price.

types.name: Long
types.description: A Scalar for the primitive long type.

types.name: PriceAndCountMetrics
types.description:
Common price and count metrics shared by query and catalog search metrics.
Groups impressions, clicks, cart adds, and purchases with their associated prices.

fields.name: cartAddsWithPrice
fields.description: Number of times added to cart from search results, with price at time of add.

fields.name: clicksWithPrice
fields.description: Number of clicks from search results, with price at time of click.

fields.name: impressionsWithPrice
fields.description: Number of times the product appeared in search results, with price at time of impression.

fields.name: oneDayMetrics
fields.description: Search performance metrics for products with one-day delivery option available.

fields.name: purchasesWithPrice
fields.description: Number of purchases from search results, with price at time of purchase.

fields.name: sameDayMetrics
fields.description: Search performance metrics for products with same-day delivery option available.

fields.name: twoDayMetrics
fields.description: Search performance metrics for products with two-day delivery option available.

fields.name: dealId
fields.description: Deal identifier.

fields.name: dealOurPrice
fields.description: Price before cart based promotions such as Lightning Deals, POS promotions and Coupons.

fields.name: dealTitle
fields.description: The title of the promotion.

fields.name: promotionAsinStateType
fields.description: Promotion ASIN state type refers to the current status or availability of a promoted product on Amazon.

fields.name: promotionConversionRate
fields.description:
Promotion conversion rate refers to the percentage of units purchased (net of
cancellations) for a product with an active promotion.
It's calculated as the number of units sold, minus any cancelled orders,
divided by the number of details page views for that promotion.

fields.name: promotionDiscountAmt
fields.description:
The difference between the price without the promotion (the Amazon landed
price) and the price after the promotion is applied to an item.

fields.name: promotionDiscountPct
fields.description:
Promotion discount % refers to the percentage discount that's applied to a product's price as part of a promotional offer.
It's calculated as the promotion's discount amount divided by the current price.

fields.name: promotionEndDate
fields.description:
Promotion end date refers to the date and time, in the local time zone for a
store, when a promotion becomes inactive in that store.

fields.name: promotionGlanceViewCnt
fields.description: This attribute gives the total count of glance views of the Promotion applicable ASINS for that reporting period.

fields.name: promotionOrderedPrice
fields.description: Promotion price is the final selling price of an item after any promotions have been applied.

fields.name: promotionOrderedUnitsWithRevenue
fields.description:
Promotion Ordered Units refers to the total number of units ordered for products that have an active promotion,
with adjustments made for order cancellations and coupon orders. It is calculated as the count of net ordered units
where promotion is active (number of units are set to zero if the order is canceled and to one for coupon orders).

Promotion ordered revenue is the total money earned from selling products that were part of a promotional offer.
It includes the selling prices, shipping fees, taxes, and gift wrap charges,
and subtracts the cost of any returned or refunded items.

fields.name: promotionStartDate
fields.description: Promotion start date refers to the date and time, in the local time zone for a store, when a promotion becomes active.

fields.name: promotionStatus
fields.description: Promotion status indicates if a promotion is approved, pending or rejected.

fields.name: promotionType
fields.description:
Identifies the type of the promotion for ASIN level data. Example values are
Best Deal, Deal of the Day, Lightning Deal, Sales Discount.

types.name: ReturnDefectTopicMetrics
types.description: Return-defect metrics at the individual defect-topic level.

fields.name: returnDefectContribution
fields.description:
Fraction (between 0 and 1) of the product's total return defects attributed to
this defect topic. Not supported under totals.

fields.name: returnDefectFrequency
fields.description: Number of return defects reported for this defect topic (trailing six months). Not supported under totals.

fields.name: returnDefectRecommendations
fields.description: Recommended actions to address the return defects associated with this topic. Not supported under totals.

fields.name: returnDefectTopic
fields.description:
Return-defect topic categorizing customer-reported product defects.
This field automatically groups results when selected, showing metrics per
unique defect topic. Not supported under totals.

types.name: Returns
types.description: Returns metric group. A null value for a given metric means that this metric is not yet available.

fields.name: returnedRate
fields.description:
Rate of returned units relative to shipped units for the selected time period,
as a fraction between 0 and 1 (returned units / shipped units). Return data is
computed with a delay of about 45 days, so the rate may appear low for recent
dates. Not supported under totals.

fields.name: returnedUnits
fields.description:
Number of units returned by customers with a resolution (refund or
replacement), including returnless refunds, mapped to the day each unit was shipped.
Return data is computed with a delay of about 45 days, so the most recent ~45 days may be empty or incomplete.

fields.name: totalRefundAmount
fields.description:
Total amount refunded to customers in the selected time period, including all
refunds, in the currency specified by the currencyCode argument (USD if not
provided). Refund data is computed with a delay of about 45 days, so the most
recent ~45 days may be empty or incomplete.

types.name: Reviews
types.description: Reviews metric group. A null value for a given metric means that this metric is not yet available.

fields.name: criticalReviewRate
fields.description:
Fraction (between 0 and 1) of customer reviews that are low-rating (critical),
calculated as lowRatingReviewCount divided by totalReviewCount. Not supported under totals.

fields.name: displayRating
fields.description:
Rounded star rating shown on the product detail page (1-5).
Reflects the overall rating state as of the requested date, not activity within the period.
Null when the product has no ratings yet. Not supported under totals.

fields.name: lowRatingReviewCount
fields.description: Number of low-rating customer reviews (critical reviews) received for the product in the selected time period.

fields.name: rawRating
fields.description:
Unrounded average star rating for the product (1-5).
Reflects the overall rating state as of the requested date, not activity within the period.
Null when the product has no ratings yet. Not supported under totals.

fields.name: totalRatingCount
fields.description:
Total number of verified buyer reviews contributing to the product's star rating, as of
the requested date. Differs from totalReviewCount, which counts reviews received in the
selected time period. Not supported under totals.

fields.name: totalReviewCount
fields.description: Total number of customer reviews received for the product in the selected time period.

types.name: Sales
types.description: Sales metric group. A null value for a given metric means that this metric is not yet available.

fields.name: averageSellingPrice
fields.description:
The average price per unit in the selected time period, calculated by dividing
net orderedProductSales by net unitsOrdered (both adjusted for cancellations).

fields.name: averageSellingPriceB2B
fields.description:
The average price of the units sold to Amazon Business customers, calculated
by dividing the orderedProductSalesB2B by unitsOrderedB2B for the selected
time period. Note: This field is only populated if you are a B2B seller on Amazon.

fields.name: orderGMS
fields.description: Total monetary value of all orders after promotions and discounts, excluding canceled orders.

fields.name: orderedProductSales
fields.description:
The amount of ordered product sales, calculated by multiplying the price of
products and the number of units sold for the selected time period.

fields.name: orderedProductSalesB2B
fields.description:
The amount of ordered product sales to Amazon Business customers, calculated
by multiplying the price of products and the number of units sold for the
selected time period. Note: This field is only populated if you are a B2B seller on Amazon.

fields.name: ordersShippedWithRevenue
fields.description: The number of orders shipped in the selected time period as well as revenue generated.

fields.name: unitsOrdered
fields.description: The number of units ordered.

fields.name: unitsShipped
fields.description: The number of units shipped in the selected time period.

fields.name: unitsShippedB2B
fields.description:
The number of units ordered by Amazon Business customers.
Note: This field is only populated if you are a B2B seller on Amazon.

types.name: SellerAttributes
types.description:
Seller-level attributes for the account. These are static and do not vary by
metric or groupBy. A null value means the attribute is not yet available.

fields.name: isBrandOwner
fields.description: Binary flag indicating whether the seller is registered as a brand owner in Amazon's Brand Registry.

fields.name: isFBARegistered
fields.description: Binary flag indicating whether seller is registered for Amazon's FBA program.

fields.name: sellerFraudStatus
fields.description: Fraud status of a merchant with default value of NormalStatus.

fields.name: sellerStoreURL
fields.description: Web address of a merchant's online storefront on Amazon displaying all their listed ASINs.

fields.name: sellerTenure
fields.description: Length of time a seller has been active on the Amazon marketplace, typically measured in days or months.

types.name: String
types.description: Represents textual data as UTF-8 character sequences. This type is most often used by GraphQL to represent free-form human-readable text.

types.name: TimeRangeBenchmarking

fields.name: monthOverMonth
fields.description: A metric that compares data from the current month to the previous month to measure performance changes.

fields.name: weekOverWeek
fields.description: A metric that compares data from the current week to the previous week to measure performance changes.

fields.name: yearOverYear
fields.description: A metric that compares data from the current period to the same period last year to measure performance changes.

types.name: Traffic
types.description: Traffic metric group. A null value for a given metric means that this metric is not yet available.

fields.name: browserPageViews
fields.description: Browser page views are the number of times a user visited your Amazon.com browser pages for the selected time period.

fields.name: browserSessions
fields.description:
Browser sessions are visits to your Amazon.com browser pages by a user. All
browser activity within a 24-hour period is considered a browser session. For
example, if a user visits your pages using a browser multiple times within a
24 hour period it is counted as a single browser session.

fields.name: conversationRatePct
fields.description:
The conversion rate describes the successful transition of a customer from clicks to purchase.
This metric includes the percentage of purchases to clicks for ASINs originated from the search results page.
fields.deprecationReason: No longer supported. Use conversionRatePct instead.

fields.name: conversionRatePct
fields.description:
The conversion rate describes the successful transition of a customer from clicks to purchase.
This metric includes the percentage of purchases to clicks for ASINs originated from the search results page.

fields.name: featureOfferGlanceViews
fields.description:
Featured Offer glance views is the count of glance views where your product
appeared as the Featured Offer on the search results page.

fields.name: featureOfferPct
fields.description:
Featured Offer percentage shows how often your offer is the Featured Offer when customers can add to their cart.
It's calculated by dividing the number of times your offer is the Featured Offer
by the number of times customers viewed it (that is, Glance Views).

fields.name: glanceViews
fields.description: Glance views is the number of times customers actively engage with your product detail page.

fields.name: glanceViewsB2B
fields.description:
Glance views B2B is the number of times customers actively engage with your product detail page.
Note: This field is only populated if you are a B2B seller on Amazon.

fields.name: mobileAppPageViews
fields.description:
Mobile app page views are the number of times a user visited your Amazon.com
mobile app pages for the selected time period.

fields.name: mobileAppSessions
fields.description:
Mobile app sessions are visits to your Amazon.com mobile app pages by a user.
All mobile app activity within a 24-hour period is considered a mobile app
session. For example, if a user visits your pages using a mobile app multiple
times within a 24 hour period it is counted as a single mobile app session.

fields.name: pageViews
fields.description:
Page views are the number of times a user visited your Amazon.com browser or
mobile app pages for the selected time period. It is calculated as the sum of
browserPageViews and mobileAppPageViews.

fields.name: sessions
fields.description:
Sessions are visits to your Amazon.com browser or mobile app pages by a user.
All browser and mobile app activity within a 24-hour period is considered a
session. It is calculated as the sum of browserSessions and mobileAppSessions.

types.name: __Directive
types.description:
A Directive provides a way to describe alternate runtime execution and type validation behavior in a GraphQL document.

In some cases, you need to provide options to alter GraphQL's execution behavior in ways field arguments will not suffice, such as conditionally including or skipping a field. Directives provide this by describing additional information to the executor.

enumValues.name: MUTATION

enumValues.name: SUBSCRIPTION

enumValues.name: FIELD
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to a field.

enumValues.name: FRAGMENT_DEFINITION
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to a fragment definition.

enumValues.name: FRAGMENT_SPREAD
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to a fragment spread.

enumValues.name: INLINE_FRAGMENT
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to an inline fragment.

enumValues.name: VARIABLE_DEFINITION
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to a variable definition.

enumValues.name: SCHEMA
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to a schema definition.

enumValues.name: SCALAR
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to a scalar definition.

enumValues.name: OBJECT
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to an object type definition.

enumValues.name: FIELD_DEFINITION
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to a field definition.

enumValues.name: ARGUMENT_DEFINITION
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to an argument definition.

enumValues.name: INTERFACE
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to an interface definition.

enumValues.name: UNION
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to a union definition.

enumValues.name: ENUM
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to an enum definition.

enumValues.name: ENUM_VALUE
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to an enum value definition.

enumValues.name: INPUT_OBJECT

enumValues.name: INPUT_FIELD_DEFINITION
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to an input object field definition.

types.name: __EnumValue
types.description: One possible value for a given Enum. Enum values are unique values, not a placeholder for a string or numeric value. However an Enum value is returned in a JSON response as a string.

types.name: __Field
types.description: Object and Interface types are described by a list of Fields, each of which has a name, potentially a list of arguments, and a return type.

types.name: __InputValue
types.description: Arguments provided to Fields or Directives and the input fields of an InputObject are represented as Input Values which describe their type and optionally a default value.

fields.name: defaultValue
fields.description: A GraphQL-formatted string representing the default value for this input value.

types.name: __Schema
types.description: A GraphQL Schema defines the capabilities of a GraphQL server. It exposes all available types and directives on the server, as well as the entry points for query, mutation, and subscription operations.

fields.name: directives
fields.description: A list of all directives supported by this server.

fields.name: mutationType
fields.description: If this server supports mutation, the type that mutation operations will be rooted at.

fields.name: queryType
fields.description: The type that query operations will be rooted at.

fields.name: subscriptionType
fields.description: If this server support subscription, the type that subscription operations will be rooted at.

fields.name: types
fields.description: A list of all types supported by this server.

types.name: __Type
types.description:
The fundamental unit of any GraphQL Schema is the type. There are many kinds of types in GraphQL as represented by the `__TypeKind` enum.

Depending on the kind of a type, certain fields describe information about that type. Scalar types provide no information beyond a name and description, while Enum types provide their values. Object and Interface types provide the fields they describe. Abstract types, Union and Interface, provide the Object types possible at runtime. List and NonNull types compose other types.

types.name: __TypeKind
types.description: An enum describing what kind of type a given `__Type` is.

enumValues.name: SCALAR
enumValues.description: Indicates this type is a scalar.

enumValues.name: OBJECT
enumValues.description: Indicates this type is an object. `fields` and `interfaces` are valid fields.

enumValues.name: INTERFACE
enumValues.description: Indicates this type is an interface. `fields` and `possibleTypes` are valid fields.

enumValues.name: UNION
enumValues.description: Indicates this type is a union. `possibleTypes` is a valid field.

enumValues.name: ENUM
enumValues.description: Indicates this type is an enum. `enumValues` is a valid field.

enumValues.name: INPUT_OBJECT
enumValues.description: Indicates this type is an input object. `inputFields` is a valid field.

enumValues.name: LIST
enumValues.description: Indicates this type is a list. `ofType` is a valid field.

enumValues.name: NON_NULL
enumValues.description: Indicates this type is a non-null. `ofType` is a valid field.

directives.name: deprecated
directives.description: Marks an element of a GraphQL schema as no longer supported.

args.name: reason
args.description: Explains why this element was deprecated, usually also including a suggestion for how to access supported similar data. Formatted in [Markdown](https://daringfireball.net/projects/markdown/).

directives.name: domainGroupBy
directives.description: A directive which indicates that selecting this field will automatically group query results by its unique values.

directives.name: domainResolver
directives.description:
A directive which is used to specify which sdp instance type executes the
operations associated with the schema it is configured for.

args.name: sdpInstanceType
args.description: The sdp instance type that will execute the GraphQL resolvers.

directives.name: include
directives.description: Directs the executor to include this field or fragment only when the `if` argument is true.

directives.name: oneOf
directives.description: Requires that exactly one field must be supplied and that field must not be `null`.

directives.name: paamRights
directives.description: A directive which is used to enforce PAAM rights.

args.name: require
args.description:
A list of PAAM rights that Data Kiosk authorizes merchant account requests
against. Requesters must have at least one right from the list to be
authorized for the associated field/query.

args.name: interest
args.description:
An optional list of PAAM rights that Data Kiosk will not authorize against,
but should be included in the PAAM TA token. These rights are meant to be
evaluated by the dataset owners for business logic or data redaction.

directives.name: paamUnionTypeRights
directives.description:
A directive which is used to enforce PAAM rights on union member types. When
querying a union type, these rights prevent callers from getting union member
types they are not authorized to access.

args.name: memberTypes
args.description: A list of TypeRights objects, each containing a union member type and the PAAM rights necessary to access it.

directives.name: resultRetention
directives.description:
This directive specifies the retention duration of a query containing a
particular field. When a query contains multiple fields with different
retentions, the shortest (minimum) retention is applied to the query. The
retention of a query's resulting documents always matches the retention of the query.

directives.name: skip
directives.description: Directs the executor to skip this field or fragment when the `if` argument is true.

directives.name: specifiedBy
directives.description: Exposes a URL that specifies the behavior of this scalar.

args.name: url
args.description: The URL that specifies the behavior of this scalar.

directives.name: supplementalRights
directives.description: A directive which is used to enforce supplemental rights.

args.name: require
args.description:
A list of supplemental rights that Data Kiosk authorizes non-merchant account
requests against. Requesters must have at least one right from the list to be
authorized for the associated field/query.

directives.name: supplementalUnionTypeRights
directives.description:
A directive which is used to enforce supplemental rights on union member types.
When querying a union type, these rights prevent callers from getting union
member types they are not authorized to access.

args.name: memberTypes
args.description: A list of TypeRights objects, each containing a union member type and the supplemental rights necessary to access it.

directives.name: supportedAccountTypes
directives.description:
A directive which is used to specify which account types are supported for a
given operation and must be applied at the operation level.

args.name: types
args.description: A list of Amazon account types to support.

directives.name: supportedConverters
directives.description:
Declares the converters that consumers are allowed to request for this
operation, identified by SDP instance type. When a query requests a converter
via `@convert(withSdpInstanceType: ...)`, Data Kiosk permits the request only if
that SDP instance type is listed here; any converter not declared is rejected at
request ingestion. Applies per operation (query field), not per domain — place
it on the query operation field.

args.name: sdpInstanceTypes
args.description:
The SDP instance types (e.g. `amzn1.sdp.1.type.1.fbmsConverter`) of the
converters allowed for this operation. A converter transforms the JSONL output
of the operation's domain document processor into another format (for example,
CSV). Must list at least one type, with no duplicates.
